title: Cratiflens Gele (Orange Jelly)
description: Prepared with oranges, lemons, and wine.

ingredients.name: wine to fill the remaining measure
7 stiff isinglass dissolved in 1 liter water
a finger-length piece of orange peel

steps: Press the juice from 4 oranges and 3 lemons through a cloth and collect the completely clear juice in a 1/4 liter measure, filling the rest with wine.
Prepare 7 stiff isinglass by cooking in 1 liter water, then strain and cook together with the juice until reduced to 1/4 liter of liquid.
Heat 40 decagrams of refined sugar to which a finger-length piece of orange peel has been added.
Cook the isinglass and sugar together for approximately 10 minutes and strain through fine, filtered linen cloth (straining cloth) into a deep bowl.
Add the prepared mixture of orange juice, lemon juice and wine (totaling 1/4 liter) to the hot liquid, stir together, add clear lemon juice if necessary.
Pour the jelly mass (not exceeding 1 liter) into a mold that has been buried in crushed ice, ensuring it stands straight and level.
Cover the filled mold with a lid, place ice over it, cover well with cloth and set in a cold place for 2 to 3 hours.
When serving, remove the mold from ice, dip briefly in hot water, dry quickly, place a platter over it, invert the mold and slowly lift it off.

The jelly should be clear, transparent and so delicate that the slightest movement causes it to tremble. It should have a pleasant sweet-sour taste and melt in the mouth. Serve immediately to preserve its beauty.

Place the casserole in a warm place
When the dough has risen once more to double height, brush it with melted crayfish butter and bake it for 1/2 to 3/4 hour in the oven

title: Echte Schildkröten-Suppe (Vrai Tortue - True Turtle Soup)
description: A soup made with onion, champignons, and turnip.
steps: Place the tortoises on a table and hold a small, glowing coal to the back of each to make them extend their heads and feet

Place them in a casserole with cold water and cook until the green color loosens from the shoulders (approximately 3/4 hour)
Meanwhile, in another casserole with 20 decagrams of melted butter, arrange the finely sliced Spanish onion, champignons, yellow turnip, celery, and parsley root
Add the tortoises with their shells and braise covered and slowly for approximately 1/3 hour until brown
Pour on 2 1/2 liters of water or pea water and add 8 decagrams of rice
Cook slowly for approximately 1 hour

title: Echten Yoghurt (True Yogurt)

steps: Boil the fresh milk well and cool to 50°C

Let the bottles rest quietly in the warm water for approximately 3 to 3¼ hours
Carefully remove the bottles from the water and place them on a table without shaking them during transport, and let them cool slowly

title: Eggs Colored Red (Eier roth zu färben)
description: Prepared with water and eggs.
steps: One day before, soak 24 decagrams of logwood shavings with 1 piece of alum in 3 liters of water in an earthen dish
Boil this for 3-4 hours, then set it aside
Boil it again the next day for the same length of time and repeat this for 3-4 days or even longer
If the liquid has reduced too much, add water as needed
Once the decoction has achieved a beautiful red color, place the eggs to be dyed into it (they must not have been washed beforehand) and boil them for 20 minutes
Then place them in cold water, remove them, lay them on a cloth or board, or on 2 wooden spoons so the liquid drains off
Once they are completely dry, coat them with dissolved gum or with a greased fine linen cloth
If one wishes to dye the eggs red with chemical dye, they are hard-boiled without being washed beforehand and then placed in fresh water
Pour cold water into a deep bowl, add 1 tablespoon of chemical dye, place the eggs in it and let them lie there until they have achieved a beautiful red color, light or dark as desired
Then let them dry as before and may coat them with gum if desired, though not with fat
The red dye used for this purpose can be obtained from any drugstore under the name 'Red dye for coloring eggs'

Wrap a conical piece of beech wood (called the tree) 1.5 feet long in two sheets of white paper, wrapping it tightly with twine
Attach the wrapped wood to a spit and wedge it firmly with wood at the fire
Make the fire from small wood so it can be controlled
Have someone turn the spit

steps: Remove the sinews from the beef, pound it, and wipe it dry with a cloth without washing it. Do not damage the fat on top; remove the tendons from the thick upper side.
Rub the meat thoroughly with pepper and salt and let it rest for 1 hour.
Line a flat pan with bacon slices, place the meat on it, and roast it at the highest possible heat for 1 hour.

title: Escalopes de Lièvre (Hare Escalopes)

Place the tenderest legs and hare trimmings in a casserole with some onion, 5 crushed juniper berries, 5 grains of each spice, 1 bay leaf, 5 sprigs thyme, 1 piece finely cut black bread, 1.25 liters red wine, 0.33 liter vinegar and 0.33 liter water

Cut similar pieces from the thigh meat
Gently flatten all pieces with a flat knife and sprinkle with salt and pepper
Lay these hare pieces in a shallow casserole buttered and lined with butter-brushed paper
Let this stand covered in a cool place until serving

Pass the strained liquid into a casserole and let it dissolve; if too thick, add 2 tablespoons Madeira wine

title: Faisan Rôti Dressé (Roasted Pheasant, Dressed)
description: Prepared with pheasant and salt.
steps: Using the eye of a trussing needle, draw out the entrails of the pheasant and replace them with a piece of white paper
Hang the pheasant by its feet in an airy place for 8-10 days
Pluck the pheasant, singe it over a flame or hot charcoal, remove any remaining pinfeathers, and wipe with a cloth
Lay the pheasant head toward you, pull the neck skin tight with the left hand, cut the skin from the back to the head with a knife, and separate it completely from the head
Carefully loosen and draw up the gullet and crop from this skin
Reach into the pheasant's interior and loosen the mucous membranes all around with your index finger
Turn the pheasant head away from you, pinch the skin under the belly with thumb and index finger, and cut it fingernail-width downward
Make an equally long cut upward toward the belly and carefully remove the heart, liver, and stomach
Wipe the pheasant inside and outside with a cloth without putting it in water
Cut off the head at the neck, close to the back, but leave the neck skin attached to the pheasant
If desired, scrape off the claws from the feet

Salt the pheasant inside and outside, then truss it as follows: Lay the pheasant on its back, place your left hand on the pheasant's breast, press the thighs toward the back with thumb and middle finger to make the breast protrude, and insert a trussing needle threaded with twine just under the wing joint, pulling it out on the other side at the same spot, pulling the twine through so that 3 fingers' width protrudes

Turn the pheasant over (lay it on its breast), at the same side where you last came out at the thigh, pull out the wing's inside joint, insert the needle a thumb's width away, pull the twine through the neck skin and back, come out at the same spot on the other side's wing, insert the needle a thumb's width below, pull the twine out, tie it to the twine protruding from the thigh, and cut it half a finger's length long
Twist the fingers back behind the neck

After this is done, insert the needle under the leg's wing joint, pull the twine out on the opposite side at the same spot, holding the twine over the foot, pull the needle through just under the breastbone, and tie the twine with the protruding end together over the opposite foot

title: Farced Chicken Drumsticks (Cuisses de poulets farcis)
description: Prepared with chicken, forcemeat, and white wine.
steps: Remove the drumsticks carefully with the skin, lay them on a moistened board and cut them apart, then remove the thighbone while keeping the knucklebone attached.

In a casserole add some fat, lay in the prepared drumsticks, and after they have braised somewhat, pour white wine and broth over them and let them braise covered until tender.

title: Farcierte Kalbschnitzel (Stuffed Veal Cutlets)
description: Prepared with veal, bread, and capers.

steps: Cut about 10 knife-back thick cutlets from a veal leg
Take 2 cutlets and pound them in a mortar or pass through a meat grinder with 8 ounces of bread softened in water and well pressed out, and 4 capers
Meanwhile, roast in 4 ounces of butter 1 tablespoon of finely cut green parsley, some onion, and finely cut mushrooms
Add the roasted mixture to the pounded veal in the mortar
Pound again with one whole egg, strain
Spread this paste knife-back thick on the pounded and salted cutlets
Roll up these cutlets and tie them with string
Place 1 finely cut head of onion, 1 small piece of carrot, and 2 mushrooms, thinly sliced, in a casserole with fat
Lay the cutlets side by side in the casserole on the vegetables
Cover with a paper bag brushed with butter
Let stew covered for 15 minutes
After this time, pour in 1/2 liter of white wine or 1/2 liter of vinegar and some soup
Stew until completely tender
Cut the cutlets into desired pieces, arrange heaped on a serving dish
Pour the defatted, strained sauce over them

description: Prepared with veal, bread, and cream.
steps: Let a piece of butter warm in a casserole; add half a pound of veal and several handfuls of maurachen, which have been washed well beforehand, and let it stew down

When stewed, chop it fine with some parsley, add salt, ground pepper and a little nutmeg, along with half a semmel soaked in milk and well pressed out, and pound the whole thing finely in a mortar, to which add a few spoonfuls of cream and 2 egg yolks

title: Faschingskrapfen (Carnival Fritters)
description: Prepared with cream, egg yolks, and beef.

ingredients.name: three loth melted good beef lard

steps: Place the flour near a heated oven one day before use to make it dry and lukewarm
Put three-quarters pound sifted flour in a bowl, salt it, and add one tablespoon ground sugar
Take half a seidel lukewarm cream, five egg yolks, three loth melted beef lard, and two tablespoons yeast, and mix everything well together

Take as much of the flour as needed to make the fritters, taking care not to make the dough too stiff - it is better to take a bit more flour out than to have it too firm; you can always add more flour later if needed
Sieve the mixture through a sieve into the bowl, stir it with the flour until the dough releases from the spoon, and then beat it well for a few moments
Flour the board well, place the dough on it, and roll it out two knife-backs thick
Dip the fritter cutter well in flour and cut out the fritters with it
Lay them on a cloth dusted with flour, place them by the warm oven, and let them rise well - they should become twice as high as they were when cut out
Do not make the dough firmer than prescribed, otherwise they will not be so light, will have too many bubbles, and will be neither as good nor as beautiful as these fritters should be

When frying, the lard must not be too hot, and the pan in which you fry them must be covered immediately after the fritters are laid in and must remain covered until they are golden brown on one side, but then no longer
Once they are equally baked on both sides, remove them, lay them on blotting paper in a sieve so the fat drains completely, keep them warm, and serve them dusted with fine sugar
These fritters should be beautifully light and have a white coating
If desired, you can also serve stewed fruit warm in a bowl alongside them

title: Faschinskrapfen (Carnival Fritters)
description: Prepared with egg yolks, yeast, and jam.
steps: Warm the flour in a bowl, add a pinch of salt and 3 dkg sugar
In a small pot, melt the butter, beat it well with 4 egg yolks and 1/2 liter lukewarm milk (everything should be only lukewarm), add to the flour, stir in the yeast
Beat the dough very smooth for about 15 minutes, cover and place near the stove to rise
After it has risen (about 1 1/2-2 hours), roll it thin on a well-floured board and cut out with a fritter cutter

Place hazelnut-sized jam in the middle, lay a second sheet of dough on top with the upper side down, press the edges with floured fingers, cut out the fritters again and place them on a floured board without touching the edges
Cover with a napkin and let them rise near the stove
When they have risen on one side, turn them over and let them rise again
Place them with the upper side down in a baking pan with plenty of hot lard, being careful not to touch the edges when placing them in
Cover the pan and shake it gently
When the fritters are golden brown, turn them and finish baking uncovered

steps: Remove the outer leaves from the cabbage.

Cook for 5-8 minutes, then drain and lay flat on a board.
Prepare and roast the English Fillet as directed.
Brush the cooked fillet with fines herbes.
Place it skin side down on the cabbage leaves.
Fold the leaves over the meat on both sides until completely wrapped.
Place in a roasting pan, sprinkle with breadcrumbs, add a little broth or water nearby, and braise at high heat for 20-25 minutes more.

title: Filsoleteig (Fillo Pastry Dough)
description: A pastry dish made with egg yolks, white wine or juice or lemon, and flour.

ingredients.name: 3 tablespoons white wine or juice of 1 lemon

steps: Spread 56 Deca fine flour on a board.
Cut 28 Deca cold, firm butter into small pieces with a knife and rub them finely with the flour.
Make a depression in the middle into which add 1/4 teaspoon of salt, 3 egg yolks, 2 whole eggs, 1/8 liter of milk cream and 3 tablespoons of white wine or the juice of 1 lemon.
Mix together with a knife, work the mass into a smooth dough, place on a flour-dusted tray, cover with cloth and let rest at a cold place for 1 hour.
After this time, roll out the dough on a flour-dusted board, fold together and repeat as indicated for 'Butterteig feinster Art' (No. 1045).

title: Fine Pickled Cucumbers (Finely Pickled Gherkins)
description: Prepared with cucumbers, cucumber, and mustard seeds.

ingredients.name: Small cucumbers, picked in dry weather
Vinegar (prepared 2 days earlier from 2 parts vinegar with 1 part water, plus 5 shallots, 5 Carambola, and 5 grains each of mixed spices)

steps: Prepare the vinegar 2 days in advance by boiling 2 parts vinegar with 1 part water
In 5 liters of prepared vinegar, add 5 shallots, 5 Carambola, and 5 grains each of various spices, boil for half an hour removing foam, and let cool in an earthenware dish
Pick small cucumbers in dry weather, lay them on cloth, sprinkle with salt, and rub with the cloth until they shine, taking no more than 1 hour
Place them in an earthenware dish, mix them together, let them sit for quarter hour, and drain on a sieve
Line the bottom of prepared jars with some cucumber herb, birch leaves, and linden leaves
Add a layer of cucumbers, then herbs and leaves again, continuing until the jar is full
On top place 5 sweet and 5 bitter mustard seeds
Pour the prepared cold vinegar over them, leaving a space 3 fingers wide at the top
Bind with covers and store in a cool, airy place
After 3 to 4 weeks the cucumbers can be enjoyed
If the vinegar becomes cloudy, strain it, mix fresh vinegar with water, boil and skim it, let it cool completely, and pour over the cucumbers, binding the jars as before
Always use a wooden spoon to remove cucumbers and ensure remaining cucumbers stay covered with vinegar and well bound
If vinegar is absorbed, replenish with fresh

title: Fisch-Farce (Fish Forcemeat)
description: Prepared with pike or perch, rolls, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: Pike or perch flesh, about 1 kilo, cleaned and deboned
12 Deca of peeled, leafy-cut rolls, grated in milk

steps: Take pike or perch flesh, skin it, remove the meat from the bones and cut it finely
Cut the peeled, leafy-cut rolls into thin pieces and grate them in milk, then stir them on the fire into a paste
Allow this paste to cool, then pound it together with the fish flesh in a mortar
Add the butter, egg yolks, and one whole egg, along with salt, then beat it well together
Pass it through a hair sieve into a deep bowl
Add flour (or potato flour if available), then if desired, a knife-point of white pepper and the same amount of nutmeg
Stir it well together and use as needed

title: Fischknödel mit Erbsensuppe (Fish Dumplings with Pea Soup)
description: A soup made with carp or pike, bread, and cream.

ingredients.name: 2 small bread rolls soaked in milk

steps: From 2 pieces of carp or pike remove the bones, peel off the skin and chop it finely
Stir 4 lots of butter fluffy with 2 small bread rolls soaked in milk, 2 tablespoons of cream, 1 whole egg and 5 egg yolks, mace and salt
Give the finely chopped fish into this batter and mix well, then make small dumplings from it
Cook the dumplings in beef lard or cook them in pea broth
When serving, add a previously made strained pea soup on top, in which one can also serve baked or water-cooked bread slices
If the farce is pounded and driven through a hair sieve, it turns out much better

title: Fischmilchsuppa (Carp Roe Soup)
description: A soup made with carp, onion, and bay leaf.
steps: Cut into a casserole 1 piece onion, 1 piece from each root vegetable, some dill, 1 bay leaf, 1 finger-width piece of lemon peel, and if available, 1 chopped carp head
Pour in approximately 2 liters cold water, add as much vinegar as needed, and let cook 1 hour
Make a dark roux with 10 deca fat and flour and pour into the boiling liquid, stirring frequently so no lumps form
Add 1/2 liter cream and necessary salt if desired, let simmer well
Strain through a sieve into another casserole and cook again
Add the cleaned and well-washed carp milt and roe to the boiling soup and let simmer approximately 1/2 hour
Remove the roe pieces, cut into pieces, and put in the soup pot, then pour the soup over them; it should have a pleasant sour taste and brown color
Serve with toasted rolls

title: Fischpudding (Fish Pudding)
description: A pudding made with haddock, white wine, and bread.

ingredients.name: ½ kg Angler or Schellfish (monkfish or haddock)

steps: Remove bones and chop 30 dkg of the prepared fish, pass it with the bread rolls (soaked in water and well pressed out) along with 2 whole eggs, grated Parmesan, 5 dkg melted butter, salt, pepper and some flour, mixing well.
Remove bones from the remaining fish, cut into cubes, salt and pepper.
Place a layer of the filling in a well-buttered, breadcrumbed pudding mold, then a layer of fish on top, alternating filling and fish, ending with filling.
Cook the pudding for 1 hour in a water bath, remove, loosen, unmold, pour the following sauce over it and serve.

For the sauce: In 4 dkg butter, let finely chopped onion turn light yellow, add flour to make a light, light roux, pour in with water or broth, add 3 peppercorns and spice berries and the deboned, finely chopped anchovies and let the sauce cook well. Strain it, pour in the wine, bring to a boil again and finally mix in 2 egg yolks (which must first be stirred with some cold water so they do not curdle). After the binding, the sauce must not boil anymore.

title: Fischsuppe (Fish Soup)
description: A soup made with fish, vegetables, and onion.

ingredients.name: Dark roux of 5 decagrams butter or fat

steps: Clean, wash, and slice the root vegetables into leaves
